items: A work permit must be issued.

The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified and carry the suitable ID 
 safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ...etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.
Isolate the pump mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be completely drained.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller.
Feeler gauge, Dial indicator
Vibrometer, Straight edge, Rags.

Measure vibration level for bearings and compare it with the setting value, 
 then analyze it and determine what to do. Also check noise.

Check pump capacity, pressure and power .if pump performance does satisfy your 
 process requirements, and process requirements have not changed, pump should 
 be disassembled, inspection, and worn parts should be replaced. Otherwise, a 
 system inspection should be done.
Check the temperature of bearing
Check the leakage of the mechanical seal
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value
Check the mechanical seal leakage
Check the pump and piping for leaks
Check the fixation, supports
Check the oil level
Check the cooling water
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting
Check the suction and delivery
Check the open suction and discharge valve
Check the oil temperature and oil leakage
Check the water temperature and water leakage
Check the vibration level
Check pump capacity
Check pump pressure and power
Check pump temperature of bearing

If pump performance does satisfy your process requirements, and process 
 requirements have not changed, pump should be disassembled, inspection, and 
 worn parts should be replaced. Otherwise, a system inspection should be done.

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified and carry the suitable ID 
 safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ...etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.
Isolate the pump mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be completely drained.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller.
Feeler gauge, Dial indicator
Vibrometer, Straight edge, Rags.
Work to be Carried Out
Pump in Operation
Measure vibration level for bearings and compare it with the setting value, 
 then analyze it and determine what to do. Also check noise.
Check pump capacity, pressure and power .if pump performance does satisfy your 
 process requirements, and process requirements have not changed, pump should 
 be disassembled, inspection, and worn parts should be replaced. Otherwise, a 
 system inspection should be done.
Check the temperature of bearing
Check the leakage of the mechanical seal
Pump out of Operation
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value
Check the mechanical seal leakage
Check the pump and piping for leaks
Check the fixation, supports
Before Starting the Pump
Check the oil level
Check the cooling water
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting
Check the suction and delivery
Check the open suction and discharge valve
During 
Operation of the Pump
Check the oil temperature and oil leakage
Check the water temperature and water leakage
Check the vibration level
Check pump capacity
Check pump pressure and power
Check pump temperature of bearing
If pump performance does satisfy your process requirements, and process 
 requirements have not changed, pump should be disassembled, inspection, and 
 worn parts should be replaced. Otherwise, a system inspection should be done.
